exposure: Developmental Dysplasia of the Hip (DDH) treated with Pavlik harness
outcome: Achievement of gross motor milestones (sitting without support, hands-and-knees crawling, walking independently)
cohort: The study included 55 children with Developmental Dysplasia of the Hip treated with Pavlik harness and 66 healthy controls without orthopedic pathology.
finding: Children with Developmental Dysplasia of the Hip, treated by Pavlik harness, did not show statistically significant delays in motor skills acquisition compared to healthy controls.
mod_finding: The prevalence of C-section delivery was significantly higher in the Developmental Dysplasia of the Hip group (60.0%) compared to the healthy control group (19.7%).
birth_weight: Not specified, but groups had no significant differences regarding birth weight.
gest_age: Not specified, but groups had no significant differences regarding gestational age.
